entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
RETURNS!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought this so-called 'Aero Race Jersey' and it's completely useless. I want to return it now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
What's the issue? The issue is that it's the wrong size! It's ridiculously too tight. I can barely breathe in it. This is unacceptable. I need to exchange this thing or get my money back immediately.
I understand your frustration. Getting an item that doesn't fit is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF8675309. You people need to fix your sizing charts. This is a complete waste of my time. If you don't resolve this, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Is that clear?

I understand, and I appreciate you providing that order number. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on November 1st. You're looking to start a return or an exchange, is that correct?
Is that not what I've been saying? Yes! An exchange, a return, I don't care. Just fix it! I swear if you tell me I'm outside some ridiculous window I'm going to want to speak to your manager.
No, not at all. Let me just check our policy... Yes, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. It's... within the window?
Yes, absolutely. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now. Did you want to exchange the jersey for a different size, or would you prefer a full refund to your original payment method?
Uh... fine. I'll do an exchange. I need a Large instead of a Medium.

Perfect. I have initiated the exchange for a size Large. I've just sent that return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to your package with the original jersey inside, and drop it at any post office. Once the return is scanned, we'll ship out your new size.
Okay. Well... good. That's what you should have done in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
